title: THE GUN MOMENTS HAVE SOUNDS
why: His order of 2026-10-15: add the sounds. The active reload now answers by ear: a press in the sweet spot is a bright lock click with a low thump, a press outside it is a dull miss, and the press that starts a reload stays quiet. The Support MG spin has its own sound, a motor engaging with a whine that climbs two octaves as the barrels wind up, and letting go plays the whine falling and the rattle slowing to a stop. The finisher lands with a heavy blow, a crunch and a bone snap of its own on top of the crowbar sound. No words, no voices, no music.
now: The active reload, the Support MG spin and the finisher have their own sounds.
